note: Starter workflow for ComfyUI + ComfyUI-GGUF. Load this in ComfyUI, select flux-2-klein-4b-Q4_K_M.gguf in the GGUF UNet loader and Qwen3-4B-Q8_0.gguf in the CLIP/text-encoder loader if node names differ after startup. Includes seed and img2img placeholders.
workflow_goal: FLUX.2 klein GGUF text-to-image and image-to-image with editable seed settings
img2img_instructions: Open ComfyUI at the Space live URL.
Use Load Image for the source image.
Encode it through the VAE, then connect latent_image into KSampler.
Set denoise between 0.35 and 0.75 for image-to-image strength.
Change seed in KSampler for deterministic variants.
